additional_info.subject: Today's Intervention summary
additional_info.body:
The LED flickering issue was resolved after the firmware update.
The charger is online on SCB but offline on OCPP.
After replacing the SIM from SCB to OCPP, SCB is back online, but OCPP is still offline. Therefore, the issue is not related to the SIM cards.
Logged into the routers and checked the status; it shows the SIM is inserted but not registered.
Tried selecting the operator manually, but it didn’t work.
The router shows 2 WAN connections. Tried logging in via MobXtem, but was unable to log in as it’s showing "denied" after multiple attempts, even after manually inserting the password instead of pasting it.
Asked to reset the router and recommission it, but RC mentioned this activity isn’t possible as the end customer is on-site.
RC will visit the site as it is near to him on
26th December
and will need support for the intervention.
RC will confirm the time on the ticket.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0395681-DC/Si-D/IL-[cRKmuD] Flickering LEDs CRM:00798001607
additional_info.body:
Hi Orel,
As we discussed on the Teams call, after resetting and recommissioning the router, the issue persists as the router is continuously showing as disconnected. After replacing the router with a new one, it came online on OCPP. This suggests that the issue is with the router.
If possible, we would kindly recommend resetting and recommissioning the router once again to see if it resolves the issue. Should it still not work, we may need to consider the router as potentially faulty.
After checking, please share the detailed activity and FSR report for case closure.
Best Regards,
Sominath Nagalgaon
eMobility Support Team
